state.name: Traveler
state.background:
Origin: Cabin Boy
Starting archetype: Swordsman
Raised around Cabin Boy, they learned the habits and pressures expected of a Swordsman. Their home life was modest and sometimes unstable, making preparation, loyalty, and self-reliance learned habits rather than slogans. They have not given a fixed account of their earlier life. Their early swordsman practice was uneven but persistent, emphasizing Agility, Strength. Marin Osgood, a former bounty hunter, supplied guidance, friction, and an unfinished expectation. The turning point came when a bounty gone wrong left a debt that could only be repaid at sea. They want to turn an uncertain beginning into earned capability and decide what place they will claim in the world. They still lack the experience and resources to turn every promising instinct into a dependable result.
